sources.title: Stress-testing the spatially flat Universe
sources.claim: GP reconstruction with a smoothness prior, SN and radial DESI DR2 BAO; baseline curvature medians are positive. Cutting SN to z>0.51 changes the PantheonPlus median to −0.085. The three baseline rows share BAO and are not independent detections.
sources.relevance: Compare sample and redshift-cut dependence before conditioning on the closed branch. CMB/absolute-calibration independence does not remove the GP prior.
sources.result_kind: published 68% credible interval summaries; no reconstructed posterior samples

sources.title: DESI DR2 Results IV: Lyα Alcock–Paczyński measurements
sources.claim: At z=2.33 the full-shape distance pair is (DM/rd,DH/rd)=(39.32±0.33,8.600±0.066), with correlation 0.225. Broadband AP=4.578±0.052; full-shape AP=4.572±0.046. Published errors include BAO systematics.
sources.relevance: Joint covariance contours and calibration-free AP comparison. The pair and AP are alternatives derived from the same data; do not combine their χ² values.
sources.read: Section III; Eqs 24–26; Figure 7; Appendix B

sources.title: Model-independent test of FLRW and curvature with DESI DR2
sources.claim: Iterative SN smoothing plus BAO gives the Ok(z) constant-curvature diagnostic. Median ΩK differs between Pantheon+ and DESY5. Reconstruction spread and median propagated 1σ error are different uncertainty summaries.
sources.relevance: Import normalized D,D′,E reconstructions with their covariance and test a single constant. A redshift trend alone does not diagnose non-FLRW geometry.

sources.title: Validation of the DESI DR2 Lyα full-shape analysis
sources.claim: CoLoRe 2LPT/AbacusSummit mocks and blinded robustness tests support AP/BAO recovery. A growth-rate bias in mocks caused the authors to exclude fσ8 from the final analysis.
sources.relevance: Retain nuisance provenance and cuts. AP geometry must not be presented as a validated Lyα growth measurement.
sources.read: Mock recovery; small-scale marginalization; UV-background tests; excluded growth parameter

sources.title: Lyα forest holography: 3D predictions from 1D measurements
sources.claim: ForestFlow is trained on hydrodynamical simulations and connects DESI 1D flux-power information to 3D clustering models and priors; validated against ACCEL-2.
sources.relevance: A sourced example of lower-dimensional reconstruction with an explicit model prior. The atlas does not run ForestFlow or derive a unique 3D universe from 1D data.
sources.read: 1D→3D mapping; emulator domain; priors; ACCEL-2 validation

sources.title: Hu–Sawicki f(R) gravity in a non-flat universe
sources.claim: Curvature, H0 and modified-gravity parameter b are correlated in a model-dependent DESI/BBN/SN inference.
sources.relevance: Preserve geometry, gravity and fitted posteriors as distinct layers. CPL controls here do not implement the Hu–Sawicki field equations.
sources.read: Section IV joint b–ΩK–H0 contours; model comparison

sources.title: ACT DR6: B-mode delensing with external structure tracers
sources.claim: ACT lensing + unWISE + Planck CIB produces a tracer with 55–85% lensing correlation for L≤2000. Reported removed lensing B-mode power: 39% for ACT ℓ=100–1500 and 47% for Planck ℓ=30–300, on 23% of the sky.
sources.relevance: Distinguish tracer correlation ρ from band-averaged B-mode removal. The 1−ρ² control is an idealized per-mode illustration, not these measured efficiencies.
sources.read: Template construction; transfer response; residual covariance; multipole/sky cuts

sources.title: ACT DR6 × DESI LRG: structure formation over cosmic time
sources.claim: Lensing–LRG cross-correlation measured in four bins spanning 0.4≤z≤1.0; the ACT-only detection is 38σ and ACT+Planck reaches 50σ in this paper. This is a 2024 preprint, not a new 2026 result.
sources.relevance: Geometry+growth+bias probe separate from BAO/AP. Kernel visualization here is a reference calculation; no C_L likelihood or galaxy-bias fit is claimed.
sources.read: Tomographic redshift kernels; C_Lκg and galaxy auto-spectrum covariance

sources.title: On cosmological singularities in string theory
sources.claim: Perturbed large-S³ string backgrounds have different radius and anisotropic deformation dynamics; not an observational determination of cosmic topology.
sources.relevance: Dynamic S³ assumptions differ from the atlas’s round FLRW reference and Bianchi IX model. No string evolution solver is implemented by this integration.
sources.read: S³ background equations; radius deformations; anisotropic perturbations

sources.title: Scalar, vector and tensor harmonics on the three-sphere
sources.claim: Discrete round-S³ eigenmodes have separate scalar, vector and tensor families. Scalar −Δ eigenvalues n(n+2)/R² have multiplicity (n+1)².
sources.relevance: Exact scalar mode explorer; vector/tensor construction remains referenced. S² observed angular multipoles ℓ are not native S³ modes n. No claim that a literature search proves absence of newer results.
sources.read: Scalar eigenvalue/normalization; vector/tensor class tables and residuals
